name: stagewise
title: stagewise.io
shortDescription: stagewise is a frontend coding tool that operates within your browser, enhancing the development of app frontends through an intuitive interface. It allows developers to select elements and make changes directly, catering to both seasoned engineers and newcomers. Ideal for rapidly iterating on design and code, stagewise integrates with major frameworks like React and Vue, making it a versatile choice for diverse development environments.
pros: Seamless integration with major web frameworks
cons: May not support all minor frameworks
